# Aspirant Arcade

> Free PSU exam preparation app for GATE-qualified engineers in India. Available on Android and web. No login required.

## What it is

Aspirant Arcade is a gamified PSU (Public Sector Undertaking) exam preparation app for Indian engineering graduates who have qualified GATE and are targeting PSU jobs. It uses Google Gemini AI to generate fresh, non-repetitive questions every session calibrated to the user's specific PSU, engineering branch, and exam syllabus.

The app is completely free. Users bring their own Google Gemini API key (free from Google AI Studio). No data is stored on any server — all progress is local to the device.

## Who it is for

- GATE-qualified B.Tech/B.E. engineers preparing for PSU written tests (CBT) and interviews
- Engineers targeting: HPCL, BHEL, ONGC, NTPC, IOCL, GAIL, SAIL, BPCL, PGCIL, HAL, BEL, Coal India, NMDC, NFL, AAI, and more
- Supported engineering branches: Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Instrumentation, CS/IT

## Key Features

- **MCQ Blitz**: Rapid-fire multiple choice questions on PSU syllabus
- **Survival Mode**: Timed MCQs with 3 lives — simulates real CBT exam pressure
- **Match the Following**: Pair concepts with definitions
- **Syllabus Slasher**: Gamified topic mastery mode
- **Technical PI Simulator**: AI mock panel interview with branch-specific technical questions
- **AI Mock GD**: Group Discussion practice with AI candidates on real PSU GD topics
- **Insights Dashboard**: Accuracy tracking per topic over time
- **Smart Bookmarks**: Save tough questions with personal notes

## Platforms

- Web app: https://aspirant-arcade.xyz
- Android APK: Direct install, no Play Store required

## How it works

1. Open the web app or install the Android APK
2. Get a free Gemini API key from Google AI Studio (no billing required)
3. Select target PSU, engineering branch, and topics
4. AI generates unique questions every session

## Privacy

No account creation. No email or phone required. All progress stored locally on device. Gemini API key stored on-device only — never sent to Aspirant Arcade servers. Zero ads, zero tracking.

## PSUs Supported

HPCL, BHEL, ONGC, NTPC, IOCL, GAIL, SAIL, BPCL, PGCIL, HAL, BEL, Coal India, NMDC, NFL, AAI, MECL, NHPC, Oil India, THDC, NEEPCO, SJVN, EIL, NALCO, RITES, IRCON
